tasks.label: 🗄️ Database: Start PostgreSQL & pgAdmin
tasks.detail: Starts PostgreSQL 16 on port 5433 and pgAdmin 4 on port 5050 in background Docker containers

tasks.label: 🚀 Backend: Start Django API Server
tasks.command: cd schoolpro-backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
tasks.detail: Activates Python 3.13 venv and boots Django development server on http://localhost:8000

tasks.label: 🎨 Frontend: Start Vite React Dev Server
tasks.detail: Starts Vite React 19 development server on http://localhost:5173

tasks.label: 🔍 Quality: Run Full System Check
tasks.detail: Runs Oxlint, TypeScript (tsc -b), Django system check, and Ruff linting

tasks.label: 🛑 Database: Stop Services
tasks.command: docker compose -f schoolpro-db/docker-compose.yml down && echo 'Stopped PostgreSQL & pgAdmin containers.'
tasks.detail: Gracefully stops and removes PostgreSQL & pgAdmin Docker containers

tasks.label: 🔄 Database: Reset & Re-seed Tables
tasks.detail: Clears persistent volumes and re-initializes all 90 tables and initial seed data

tasks.label: 🧹 Database: Reset Tables (Clean - No Seed)
tasks.detail: Clears persistent volumes and re-initializes all tables WITHOUT initial seed data

tasks.label: 🌱 Database: Seed All Data (Python db_seed)
tasks.command: cd schoolpro-backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python manage.py db_seed
tasks.detail: Seeds full initial & demo data (Superadmin, Lookups, Infrastructure, Classes, Teachers, Students, Operations)
